_how_to_add_a_case: Add an object to 'cases' with file/applicant_name/pan_number/address/pages/expected_codes. 'pages' is a list of text pages rendered into a digital PDF by the eval script (no binaries in the repo). 'expected_codes' uses the contracts section 11 vocabulary. 'expected_values' lists ground-truth fields the pipeline must extract. Then run: python scripts/eval_gemini_models.py --models gemini-2.5-flash --fixtures tests/fixtures/eval --out outputs/eval.csv
